project.name: Heritage Sanctuary Precinct
project.site_description: Community-led precinct proposed by an Aboriginal community corporation. Built-form area (education/training, workshops, offices, gallery, cafe) on a freehold former golf clubhouse parcel; heritage sanctuary space on the abutting Crown reserve. Constraints: asbestos in the existing clubhouse, BAL-29 bushfire zone, heritage-sensitive areas, possible soil contamination. Full brief — including corporation, lease and lot particulars — is PRIVATE AND CONFIDENTIAL and is available under administrative authorisation only.

parcels.name: Freehold clubhouse parcel
parcels.notes: 8,498 sqm former golf clubhouse - training facilities, cafe, theatre, offices, gallery.

parcels.name: Adjacent Crown reserve
parcels.notes: Former golf course, zoned recreation and public access. Native seed nursery, cultural garden, carbon farming, walking trails.

rezoning.notes: Rezoning of the 40ha reserve required for commercial/education use; separate WAPC and local government application.

funding.named_program: Regional Precincts and Partnerships Program (rPPP) - Stream One

ongoing_revenue_streams.name: Carbon farming (ACCU credits)
ongoing_revenue_streams.notes: 40ha carbon-farm targeting ACCU credits - value not yet estimated, pending baseline carbon stock assessment.

ongoing_revenue_streams.name: Native seed nursery sales
ongoing_revenue_streams.notes: Supplies carbon nursery stock and local horticulture markets - value not yet estimated.
